critical_path.rationale: DFS found no back-edges (PASS). Longest path over blocking edges only (depends-on/blocks; integrates-with excluded): order-service -[blocks]-> points-ledger -[depends-on]-> redemption-engine, length 2. Single root (order-service is the only node with no incoming blocking edge); no other root produces a chain of equal length, so no tie.
